title: Telemetry sender app
brief: Screens for the app that captures vehicle telemetry (device_id, seq, captured_at, lat/lon, speed_kmh, heading_deg, accuracy_m, mode moving|heartbeat) and sends batches to POST /v1/telemetry in fleet-telemetry. Three directions for the same sender app.

artboards.title: Ops console — alert detail and workflow
artboards.tradeoff: Alert instance view: timeline (fired, notified, ack, note), who has it, operator notes thread, and actions (escalate, reassign, resolve, silence, false positive) with the alert context pinned on the map

artboards.title: Ops console — command palette and shortcuts
artboards.tradeoff: Cmd+K palette over the dimmed console: grouped device / action / navigation results with keyboard hints, plus the shortcuts sheet

artboards.title: Ops console — 24 h replay
artboards.tradeoff: Timeline scrubber with playhead, play/pause, speed and alert markers; positions rebuilt from stored samples with seq gaps shown as dashed jumps

artboards.title: Ops console — watchlist (star + manual order)
artboards.tradeoff: One Watched concept instead of separate star and pin: star is membership (per operator, server-saved), drag order is the pin; the list doubles as map highlight, alert scope and follow group

artboards.title: Ops console — follow mode
artboards.tradeoff: Camera lock on a device or the watched group, with pan-pauses-follow plus Resume, trail window, and a stop-follow rule when the device goes stale

artboards.title: Ops console — pipeline & data health
artboards.tradeoff: KPIs with sparklines, stage funnel (device → intake → journal → consumer → Postgres), blocked watermarks, rejected events with recovery, per-partition lag; dense but the differentiator of the product

artboards.title: Ops console — connection and data states
artboards.tradeoff: State sheet: SSE disconnected banner, per-device data age with thresholds, empty, error and skeleton loading; explicit so the operator never guesses freshness

artboards.title: Ops console — alert rules and routing
artboards.tradeoff: Rule list plus detail editor: condition builder, scope, channels, quiet hours, escalation and dedupe semantics; the configuration side of the alerting module

artboards.title: Ops console — device detail drill-down
artboards.tradeoff: Right rail becomes the selected unit's fiche (tabs Alerts/Device/Assistant): live snapshot, data integrity (seq, watermark, gaps, dedup), shift totals, activity and actions; adds a follow-on-map card and highlighted marker

artboards.title: Ops console v2 — alerts, assistant and map
artboards.tradeoff: Dark operations desk: fleet sidebar with status chips, Google-Maps-style dark map with clusters and alert pin, alert rail with actions, and the Fleet Assistant (T6) panel

artboards.title: Ops console (v1)
artboards.tradeoff: First direction, kept for comparison; lighter, no alerts or assistant

artboards.title: Wire inspector
artboards.tradeoff: Transparent about the contract: JSON payload, dedup, skew and watermark visible; intimidating for non-technical staff

artboards.title: Drive — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Chosen direction: blue gradient hero shell holding the speed ring, today stats card and delivery timeline

artboards.title: Queue — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet One redesign of the batch queue: summary strip, per-batch cards with detail rows and contract note

artboards.title: Sync — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet One redesign of sync: green status hero, clock and endpoint cards, primary/secondary actions

artboards.title: More — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Fleet One redesign of settings: unit card, working System/Light/Dark theme switch, SVG icon rows, scrollable

artboards.title: Move tracker (reassignment) — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Reached from More's Move tracker row: warns the current link releases, keeps the device_id, targets a new unit; cancelable

artboards.title: Mesh mark — chosen brand symbol
artboards.tradeoff: Refined node mesh: hub + triangle of fleet nodes, accent reporting node; shown at 3 sizes plus lockup

artboards.title: Splash — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Brand entry: mark, wordmark, config check loader; shown while the app decides first-run vs. resume

artboards.title: Welcome — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: First-run only: three value cards and the Set up my tracker CTA that leads into Add tracker; includes data policy note

artboards.title: Add tracker (first-time setup) — fleet one system
artboards.tradeoff: Modal wizard for initial pairing: type or scan device code, vehicle type, pick unit; no app nav, unit unknown until chosen
